title: Beautiful Images, Toxic Words: Understanding and Addressing Offensive Text in Generated Images
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focused on general NSFW (Not Safe For Work) text, including insults, racial slurs, and sexually explicit terms embedded in generated images.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the generation of general offensive and sexually explicit text within images by diffusion models.
